text:
incident-bot: PAGE: Cedar Health (vpc-cedar-prod) — elevated request latency > 95th for last 5m. Sev: P1. Pager: oncall-eng.

maria: I'm on it, grabbing logs + topology. tagging @aj for routing checks.

aj: looking at routing now — control plane shows healthy, but one dedicated pool (cedar-01) reports high GPU queue.

devon: seeing KV cache pressure and large prefix churn from tenant ced-analytics. Could be noisy tenant.

samir: can we isolate tenant on cedar-01? current pool has mixed tenants.

isobel: I can coordinate a soft isolation — scale up a new ephemeral pool and drain ced-analytics. will need 2 GPUs, 30m.

pm-chelsea: customer CSM is on standby. We should prepare a concise customer note if we need to move traffic.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) spin up cedar-temp-iso (2xA100) 2) attach ced-analytics there, 3) monitor 95th latency. Initiating now.

incident-bot: deploy-started by isobel at 1734568012 — cedar-temp-iso provisioning.

aj: routing policy needs a slight tweak for affinity. pushing a short-lived rule: prefer cedar-temp-iso for ced-analytics.

devon: applied rule, rerouting ~18% of traffic so far. queue depth dropping.

samir: observed per-tenant token spike from a single API key (ced-analytics-key-3) — looks like a backfill job.

isobel: drain started for cedar-01. draining 2 pods, ETA ~8m.

maria: 95th latency improved from 1.2s -> 350ms after the first wave of reroutes. still watching.

pm-chelsea: heads-up — CSM pinged: they saw ~25 minutes of elevated latency impacting batch exports for their analytics team. They want credits and an exec note.

csm-jordan: sending initial customer-facing note now: "We detected elevated latency for your VPC tenant, isolated noisy tenant, and restored baseline latency. We'll follow up with RCA and proposed credits."

eng-lead-anya: good. please capture exact window and impacted endpoints. Also collect QPS and error rates for support ticket.

maria: capture: impact window 1734567830 - 1734568100 (≈4.5m spike + drain tail). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (chat), /v1/embeddings (bulk). Peak 95th = 1.25s. Normal baseline 95th ~320ms.

devon: confirm: no increased 5xxs. Root cause is noisy tenant backfill + KV cache churn causing increased CPU on shard.

isobel: cedar-temp-iso fully active and serving ced-analytics; cedar-01 drained of heavy jobs.

samir: recommended follow-ups: 1) tenant rate-limiter tweak for ced-analytics quota, 2) alert rule for sustained prefix churn, 3) add a dedicated batch slot for analytics workloads in their contract.

pm-chelsea: will propose credits: 10% of monthly committed capacity for the impacted region for the month; will confirm with finance.

csm-jordan: customer asked for an exec-ready summary by EOD. Can we draft?

eng-lead-anya: I'll draft an exec summary + RCA high-level. Maria/devon, share logs & timeline into the doc.

maria: link to logs: https://internal-redwood/logs/cedar/1734567 — (redacted in thread). included top queries and token counts.

devon: adding traces: svc-routing spans show queueing on cedar-01 shard 4.

isobel: ops TODOs: post-incident cleanup (tear down cedar-temp-iso at 1734569000), validate drain didn't drop requests, add drain-playbook note.

pm-chelsea: communications plan: 1) immediate short note sent (CSM did), 2) follow-up RCA + exec note by EOD, 3) propose credits + SLA change for batch throughput discussed next week.

csm-jordan: customer accepted immediate note and asked for timeline for RCA. Provided ETA: today 6pm PST.

samir: for the RCA include mitigation steps, root cause (noisy backfill, KV churn), and a long-term action: tenant QoS & explicit batch capacity.

maria: preliminary RCA bullets: - What: Elevated latency for VPC cedar-prod impacting Cedar Health batch exports. - When: 1734567830–1734568100. - Why: Backfill job from ced-analytics caused sustained prefix churn, increased KV cache misses and CPU pressure on dedicated pool cedar-01. - Impact: ~25m of degraded tail latency for certain batch endpoints, no 5xx. - Mitigation: spun up cedar-temp-iso, rerouted noisy tenant, drained heavy pods, latency restored.

eng-lead-anya: please also include suggested credit amount and rationale. Chelsea, Jordan coordinate with finance.

pm-chelsea: finance checkpoint: prelim ok for 10% credit for month, will confirm final number by 1734570000.

csm-jordan: I'll draft the exec note: short, apologetic, clear steps, and commit to a follow-up call if they want.

isobel: operational recommendation: create an automated isolation runbook for dedicated pools that detects tenant-induced KV churn > threshold and cold-starts temp pools automatically.

samir: agree — also add alert for per-API-key token rate increases >X for Y minutes.

maria: closing loop: cedar-prod baseline restored at 1734568130. Post-incident tasks assigned in tracker.

incident-bot: incident resolved at 1734568210 — summary posted to incidents log.

eng-lead-anya: thanks team. Action items: 1) finalize RCA draft (maria + devon) 2) comms + credit proposal (pm-chelsea + csm-jordan) 3) runbook + alerts (isobel + samir) — due EOD.

csm-jordan: I'll follow up with customer once RCA + credit numbers are confirmed.

maria: uploading RCA draft to Google Drive now and will ping for review.

pm-chelsea: will sync with finance and share final credit wording.

aj: closing my routing checks — looks stable. back to standby.

devon: adding a note to the evals team: consider model-run heuristics to reduce cache churn for batch pipelines.

isobel: tearing down cedar-temp-iso at 1734569005 per schedule.

csm-jordan: thanks everyone — good mitigation. :white_check_mark:
